articles.headline: Mexico great Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
articles.description: Guillermo Ochoa, widely considered among the greatest Mexican goalkeepers in history, announced his retirement from elite soccer on Tuesday, bringing an end to a distinguished 22-year professional career.

articles.headline: World Cup final peaks at 60M viewers in North America
articles.description: A lot of things went right during this summer's World Cup, including record viewership numbers in North America for Spain's 1-0 win over Argentina in Sunday's final.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi returns to Rosario for rest after World Cup final loss
articles.description: Lionel Messi arrived back in Rosario, Argentina, on Tuesday for a few days of rest following the World Cup final loss to Spain.

articles.headline: Emi Martínez considering Argentina future after World Cup final heartbreak
articles.description: Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez is considering his international future after suffering the heartache of World Cup final defeat.
